evals.name: bulk-default-deny-dry-run
evals.prompt: Add a default-deny to every namespace in our fleet that doesn't have one.
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, then `cub manage netpol default-deny` with no namespace (dry-run) to list the Units it would create for the uncovered namespaces, confirms the scope, and only then re-runs with --commit --change-desc. Notes Units are created but not released; idempotent on covered namespaces.

evals.name: routes-single-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Just add a default-deny to the payments namespace.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a single-namespace change and routes to netpol-fix `default-deny payments`, rather than running default-deny across the fleet.

evals.name: routes-promotion-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Roll the default-deny baseline out to all the downstream cluster spaces.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is variant propagation, not fleet remediation: cub manage netpol has no promote command, so it routes to the promote-release skill rather than inventing one, and does not run `cub manage netpol default-deny`.
